messages:
alex: Morning — planning the 02:00 cutover for the runtime bundle (engine-quant v7 -> v8). Targeting quiet window; want to confirm pin/rollback playbook before schedule.

nisha: Confirming canary slice?

alex: 2% global initially, 10% in us-west2 for 30m, then 25% if no red flags. Roll forward only after 45m stable.

marco: FYI v8 includes the matmul microkernel ABI change. Do NOT push to regions with older driver (asia-east1) until drivers are rolled.

alex: Good catch. We'll exclude asia-east1 from early slices and pin legacy pool there.

deploybot: [actionable] deploy scheduled by alex — start=2026-03-22T02:00:00Z target=engine-quant:v8 commit=sha256:abcd1234 mode=canary

sara_ops: Adding rollback criteria: 1) 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m, 2) p50 latency increase > 15% for 10m, 3) p95 increase > 25% or OOMs observed, 4) quality regression flagged by eval harness => immediate rollback.

nisha: Also add: increase in KV cache miss rate > 12% sustained for 15m as a tie-breaker (we saw perf issues last time).

alex: Agreed. I'll pin the night pool for 6h and add a manual hold if any of those triggers hit.

alex: Pin command (running now):
```
deploybot pin --service=engine-quant --version=v8 --regions=us-west2,us-east1 --exclude=asia-east1 --ttl=6h --note="night-cutover-canary"
```

deploybot: pin recorded — engine-quant:v8 pinned in us-west2,us-east1 (exclude asia-east1). TTL=6h.

smokebot: staging smoke ok: all endpoints + streaming and embeddings passed. Logs: no OOM, no kernel panics.

marco: I'll run a quick perf diff on a representative prompt set and post numbers in 15m.

alex: Release note draft bullets (please edit):
- engine-quant v8: updated matmul microkernel, improved batching throughput at long sequences, ABI tweak (see compatibility notes).
- Canary rollout 2% global -> 10% us-west2 -> 25% on success.
- asia-east1 excluded until driver roll.
- Rollback criteria and monitoring enabled.

nisha: nit: add "recommended pin for legacy customers: engine-quant:v7 is still supported"

alex: added. Will publish short blurb after canary looks clean.

smokebot: canary launched: 2% global, 10% us-west2. Telemetry stream id=rb-20260322-01

alex: Watching p50/p95/traces. If p95 > 1200ms or error budget crosses threshold I will call hold.

marco: perf snapshot after 10m (us-west2 canary): p50 -4%, p95 -2%, cpu usage +6% avg, kv-miss +1.2% — looks fine.

nisha: quality eval running on canary prompts — will post pass/fail in ~20m.

sara_ops: tagging oncall: @sara_ops will own drill if rollback needed. Ops runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/runtime-deploy-rollback

deploybot: canary at 30m: increased to 10% global and 25% us-west2 per rollout plan.

alex: Good. Leaving for handoff to overnight oncall — @sara_ops please monitor the thresholds above and escalate to the oncall group if any trigger hits.

sara_ops: Ack. If rollback needed I will use:
```
deploybot rollback --service=engine-quant --to-version=v7 --reason="canary-trigger:<metric>" --force
```

alex: One more: add a short note to release notes about ABI compatibility and driver requirements — mark as "action required" for infra teams in asia.

nisha: Will add infra action item and ping platform squad.

smokebot: quality eval: PASS (no semantic regressions on sampled prompts).

marco: final perf check at 45m: stable. No increase in error budget.

alex: closing thread — canary healthy, proceeding to full rollout tomorrow morning during daytime window. Release note will be published in 30m. Thanks all :tada:

sara_ops: copying summary to release-notes channel and setting reminder to unpin if TTL expires.

deploybot: pin TTL expired in us-east1 — unpin performed automatically.

alex: re-pinning short-term while we finalize notes (manual):
```
deploybot pin --service=engine-quant --version=v8 --regions=us-east1 --ttl=2h --note="post-canary-finalize-notes"
```

deploybot: pin recorded — us-east1 TTL=2h."
